_doc: Historical car model identity: exact constructor + exact season -> the chassis name raced that season. Every entry cites at least one reference work pinned to a revision plus the open identity record (Wikidata). Used for historical team pages and car galleries; the current season's label stays in machine-<season>.json (first-party sources only). Never inferred from a photo or from another season.

wp-jaguar-r1.title: Jaguar R1
wp-jaguar-r1.fact: car with which Jaguar Racing competed in the 2000 Formula One World Championship; debut 2000 Australian Grand Prix; predecessor Stewart SF3

wp-jaguar-r2.title: Jaguar R2
wp-jaguar-r2.fact: car with which the Jaguar team competed in the 2001 Formula One World Championship; debut 2001 Australian Grand Prix

wp-jaguar-r3.title: Jaguar R3
wp-jaguar-r3.fact: car with which Jaguar Racing competed in the 2002 Formula One season (R3B B-spec from the 2002 British Grand Prix)

wp-jaguar-r4.title: Jaguar R4
wp-jaguar-r4.fact: car with which Jaguar Racing competed in the 2003 Formula One season

wp-jaguar-r5.title: Jaguar R5
wp-jaguar-r5.fact: car used by Jaguar Racing to contest the 2004 Formula One season; last chassis made by Jaguar Racing (R5B used for two races)

wp-red-bull-rb1.title: Red Bull RB1
wp-red-bull-rb1.fact: designed by Jaguar Racing for the 2005 season (originally Jaguar R6) and used by Red Bull Racing after the buyout

wp-stewart-sf3.title: Stewart SF3
wp-stewart-sf3.fact: car with which Stewart Grand Prix competed in the 1999 Formula One World Championship; final car known as a Stewart

models.note: R3B B-specification from the 2002 British Grand Prix
